    bands=[]; r=0

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; relations=[]
    for ti,(ta,tb,trows) in enumerate(bands):
        tcount=sum(map(len,trows)); candidates=[]
        for si,(sa,sb,srows) in enumerate(bands):
            scount=sum(map(len,srows))

            for shift in range(-w+1,w):

                    extra.extend((ta+j,c) for c in tgt-shifted)

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    bands=[]; r=0
    while r<h:
        if not active[r]: r+=1; continue
        a=r
        while r<h and active[r]: r+=1
        bands.append((a,r,[{c for c,v in enumerate(grid[y]) if v!=bg} for y in range(a,r)]))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; relations=[]
    for ti,(ta,tb,trows) in enumerate(bands):
        tcount=sum(map(len,trows)); compatible=[(si,x) for si,x in enumerate(bands) if si!=ti and len(x[2])==len(trows) and sum(map(len,x[2]))>tcount]
        if not compatible: continue
        maxcount=max(sum(map(len,x[2])) for si,x in compatible)
        candidates=[]
        for si,(sa,sb,srows) in compatible:
            scount=sum(map(len,srows))
            if scount!=maxcount: continue
            for shift in range(-w+1,w):
                missing=[]; extra=[]; lost=0
                for j,(src,tgt) in enumerate(zip(srows,trows)):
                    shifted_all={c+shift for c in src}; shifted={c for c in shifted_all if 0<=c<w}
                    lost+=len(shifted_all)-len(shifted)
                    missing.extend((ta+j,c) for c in shifted-tgt)
                    extra.extend((ta+j,c) for c in tgt-shifted)
                diff=len(missing)+len(extra)+lost
                candidates.append((diff,len(extra),abs(shift),shift,missing,extra,lost,sa))
        cand=min(candidates,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2]))
        diff,nextra,_,shift,missing,extra,lost,sa=cand
        denom=max(maxcount,tcount)
        if missing and (nextra==0 or diff/max(1,denom)<=0.30):
            relations.append((ta,sa,shift,diff,nextra,missing,extra,lost))
            for rr,cc in missing: out[rr][cc]=1
    if verbose:
        print('bg',bg,'bands',[(a,b,sum(map(len,rows))) for a,b,rows in bands])
        for x in relations: print('relation',x[:5], 'missing',x[5], 'extra',x[6], 'lost',x[7])

        bands.append((a,r,[{c for c,v in enumerate(grid[y]) if v!=bg} for y in range(a,r)]))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; relations=[]
    for ti,(ta,tb,trows) in enumerate(bands):
        tcount=sum(map(len,trows))
        compatible=[x for si,x in enumerate(bands) if si!=ti and len(x[2])==len(trows) and sum(map(len,x[2]))>tcount]
        if not compatible: continue
        maxcount=max(sum(map(len,x[2])) for x in compatible)
        sources=[x for x in compatible if sum(map(len,x[2]))==maxcount]
        # Straight horizontal bars use their common left alignment, not a cropped shift.
        simple=all((not row) or row==set(range(min(row),max(row)+1)) for row in trows+sources[0][2])

        for sa,sb,srows in sources:

                diff=len(missing)+len(extra)

        diff,nextra,_,shift,missing,extra,sa=best

    if verbose:

        for x in relations: print('relation',x[:5],'missing',x[5],'extra',x[6])
